scope: Pin read-only reference implementations used for the launch-input design.

sources.name: DarwinBoot
sources.conclusion: Structure/size checks and payload loading before XNU; no nonce or Apple IM4M producer found in this Boot path. Current module source is a reference, not a claim that the fixed CI40014018074 FD was built at this commit.

sources.name: VerifiedRoot
sources.conclusion: Owner RSA3072/PKCS1v1.5/SHA256 signatures and ordered block hashes require an owner key anchor, crypto provider and authenticated image set. Not transplanted as an early Apple manifest or replaced with a synthetic hash.

sources.conclusion: SHA384 of the fixed string sweet boot manifest is compatibility reference only, never used as the nuwa manifest.

sources.name: uefi-nuwa RNG consumer
